label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Alzheimer's cognitive-impairment study provides no EMC tumor-scope evidence. Broad severe-illness and brain-MRI restrictions are not universal EMC exclusions.
cohort_reconciliation: KarXT/KarX-EC and placebo arms share mild-to-moderate Alzheimer disease eligibility; no oncology cohort.
extra_biomarker_requirement: AD pathology confirmation is required, not tumor molecular matching.
protocol_uncertainty: Other protocol-defined criteria apply; full protocol unavailable and cancer comorbidity applicability unknown.
quotes: Participants must have a confirmed diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD)

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Crohn's study supplies no EMC tumor-scope evidence; brain-tumor and serious unstable comorbidity exclusions are conditional, not a blanket EMC exclusion.
cohort_reconciliation: Part A/B active-dose and placebo induction groups all move to MORF-057 maintenance, with extension opportunity; all remain Crohn's cohorts.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No tumor fusion or molecular gate.
protocol_uncertainty: Only key criteria saved and external protocol unreviewed. Summary's three dose regimens and arm listings of two regimens per part require protocol interpretation; neither broadens histology.
quotes: Has signs/symptoms of CD for at least 90 days prior to screening
Has a concurrent, clinically significant, serious, unstable comorbidity

label: broad_tumor_compatible
rationale: Solid-tumor inclusion is explicitly non-exhaustive, supporting broad histologic scope, but the known-CDH3-expression wording is an unresolved molecular/expression gate. The expansion's EMC abbreviation explicitly means endometrial cancer, not sarcoma.
cohort_reconciliation: Phase Ia dose escalation shares non-exhaustive advanced-solid-tumor criteria.

Phase Ib selects about 3-4 expansion cohorts focused on named carcinomas and anticipated activity; exact EMC-sarcoma inclusion is not established by those examples. Broad trial-level scope does not establish an open expansion slot.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Known CDH3 expression appears in eligibility; whether histology-level expectation or individual assay is required is unclear. EMC CDH3 expression is unestablished and cannot be assumed.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol, expression threshold/assay and sponsor acceptance of unlisted EMC unavailable. Old snapshot verification and SMC-dependent RP2D/expansion decisions preclude live availability claims. Broad label must remain conditional.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: The opening inclusion criterion explicitly names EMC among subtypes not allowed. Prior anthracycline response does not negate that disease exclusion.
cohort_reconciliation: PLD maintenance and surveillance control share the exclusion; no crossover or separate EMC cohort.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No molecular route overrides histologic exclusion.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed. Registry rationale about chemotherapy standards is source language only, not a clinical recommendation; age boundary and other constraints remain individual questions.
